notes.title: Oh So Hero! v1.03.002 Bug Fix Build
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341942/db9b8c57bb4228cff788ac4b4610acd67acecd2b.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Summary:[/h1][p]This is the third bug fix release following our launch of Act 1. Aside from these fixes, we are continuing our work on localization and updated animations. Going forward, we will return to our schedule of one build per month, but each build will come with more updates![/p][p][/p][h1]Build changelog:[/h1][p]Here are the changes made since the last release (v1.02.001)...[/p][h2][b]New features:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]A new piece of environmental art, a street art mural, now adorns the section of Lood City W. Ave. near Octo's Sushi Place, exactly where the enemy gauntlet is located for this area.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Improvements & bug fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Another possible fix for Bates Encounter Lock-Up [u][url="http://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/184"]T#184[/url][/u].[/b][/p][list][*][p]By manipulating save data in a particular manner, we were able to reproduce the bug [i]and[/i] create a fix for it. We are unsure if there are other causes for this bug, but will be monitoring reports and taking action as needed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Possible fix for issue where defeating Bates is not triggering his defeat cutscene [u][url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/211"]T#211[/url][/u].[/p][list][*][p]While we were not able to reproduce this bug, our fix for T#184 may mitigate this. Please [u][url="mailto:Full.Frontal.Frog@gmail.com"]email us[/url][/u] [u][url="https://wiki.ohsohero.com/error_logs"]error logs[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://wiki.ohsohero.com/save_data"]save data[/url][/u] if you are still experiencing this bug![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When starting a new game and viewing the intro cutscene (pre-game story) Joe will not be controllable, so pressing buttons will not create sound effects of Joe punching or performing other actions [u][url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/158"]T#158[/url][/u].[/p][/*][*][p]When viewing animations in the gallery, the entity (character or environment) name atop the animation menu is now properly formatted (e.g., "Lono'e" instead of "Lonoe") [u][url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/167"]T#167[/url][/u].[/p][/*][*][p]And even more fixes that are too trivial to list![/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][u][url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues"]All Known Issues[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Oh So Hero! v1.02.001 Bug Fix Build
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341942/9d2a3812dbebea52ca5671ee2d75f2e60d044afa.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Summary:[/h1][p]This is another bug fix release. We hope this helps those of you who have had trouble running the game. Beyond that, we've been progressing on improvements and new features internally. This stuff's not ready to go live just yet, but I hope we can present some of it to you before the end of the month![/p][p][/p][h1]Build changelog:[/h1][p]Here are the changes made since the last release (v1.01.001)...[/p][h2][b]Improvements & bug fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Fix save files[/b] - Fix [url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/204"][u]T#204[/u][/url] / [url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/196"][u]T#196[/u][/url] (save file upgrade) ++[/p][list][*][p]Fix upgrading the save file from a very old version (most likely Pre Edition II).[/p][/*][*][p]Any save file that encounters an error while being read will now display its gameplay duration as "ERROR" instead of "NEW".[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Possible fix for Bates Encounter Lock-Up[/b] [url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/184"][u]T#184[/u][/url][/p][list][*][p]Although we have not been able to replicate this bug, we've changed the way the code is structured and addressed potential problem points in hopes that this will solve the problem for those experiencing it.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Bugged dialogue with Lin after defeating Bates [url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/208"][u]T#208[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Ninja Clan attack sounds play if Joe crosses the line while invincible [url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues/209"][u]T#209[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://github.com/FullFrontalFrog/OhSoHeroTracker/issues"][u]All Known Issues[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Other notes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It has been reported that the Steam version of the game is not properly showing the PlayStation button glyphs when using a DualShock or DualSense controller, even though we have built-in support for this that works properly on non-Steam builds. We have adjusted the [b]Steam Input[/b] settings in an attempt to fix this. Please let us know in the Steam discussion boards if you experience any problems.[/p][/*][*][p]We're continuing to make progress on localization. You may notice a Language setting in the Options menu. Currently "English -US-" is the only option available for this, so don't get too excited just yet! We'll make sure to let you know whenever a new language becomes available~[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Oh So Hero! Act 1 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]Oh So Hero! Act 1 Release Announcement[/h1]

[b][i]Oh So Hero! Act 1[/i] releases 5/23/25 for $9.99 USD![/b]

The completed first act will be available for purchase on May 23rd, 2025 at 5:00 pm CDT (World Turtle Day).

Steam builds will be available for PC/Mac/Linux, and will have achievements!


[h2]Game Updates[/h2]

The Steam builds of [i]Oh So Hero![/i] will continue to get important bug fixes, additional languages, and select quality of life improvements for Act 1. These will come free with your one-time purchase.

Act 2 will be developed as an expansion (DLC) which will be purchasable at a later date.


[h2]Gearing Up for Release[/h2]

We've got a lot to prepare and share prior to release, and want to reach as many people as possible! If you have expertise in marketing and promotion and would like to help, please [url=https://wiki.ohsohero.com/contact]contact us[/url] or fill out [url=https://forms.gle/vgZPAfTKUMUwaozg8]our contributor form[/url]. 


We hope you all are looking forward to the release of [i]Oh So Hero! Act 1[/i]. We'll have more to share with you all soon!


Thank You,

Ket Ralus and Red Emption

Full Frontal Frog
